lines.1: 「Yo! Sporting a gentle smile, Shin-san has come to hang out!」
lines.2: 「Get out before I count to five.」
lines.3: I glared at the thing that had come in through the window.
lines.4: 「The urban legend was true--friends really do turn cold once you get a girlfriend! Waaaaah!」
lines.7: 「How did Fukahire find out that Konoe and I started dating?」
lines.8: We'd been to crowded places like the arcade that day. Maybe people already thought we were a couple.
lines.9: 「Right. Konoe and I are dating now. I need to get my act together.」
lines.10: Thanks to him, I finally relaxed.
